recent_posts.title:
Interesting timing. 

the Anthropic-xAI compute deal doubled Claude Code's rate limits overnight

and all it took was two rival CEOs realizing they need each other more than they need to tweet about each other.
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic and xAI struck a compute deal that resulted in Claude Code's rate limits being doubled overnight. The post frames this as a notable shift where two rival AI company CEOs chose collaboration over public rivalry.

recent_posts.title: Wow.  XAI selling their compute to Anthropic because they can’t use it all
recent_posts.summary: A brief claim that xAI is selling excess compute capacity to Anthropic because xAI cannot fully utilize it themselves. No supporting details, sources, or context are provided.

recent_posts.title:
AI made junior roles almost impossible to get.

Companies think: "Why hire a junior when AI can do junior-level work?"

If nobody hires juniors today, nobody will have seniors in 5 years.

RT @trikcode: the best AI devs aren’t just good at coding.

they’re good at thinking.
recent_posts.summary: A brief social media post suggesting that the best AI developers excel at thinking, not just coding.

recent_posts.title:
the best AI devs aren’t just good at coding.

they’re good at thinking.
recent_posts.summary: The best AI developers distinguish themselves not just through coding ability but through strong thinking and reasoning skills. Technical proficiency alone is insufficient; the capacity for clear, structured thought is what separates top AI developers from the rest.

recent_posts.title:
the average dev workflow now is:

Claude for reasoning
Cursor for speed
Perplexity for research

and twitter for emotional support
recent_posts.summary: A humorous take on the modern developer's AI-assisted workflow, listing Claude for reasoning, Cursor for coding speed, and Perplexity for research, with Twitter as the tongue-in-cheek 'emotional support' tool.

recent_posts.title: 𝕏 is the new Silicon Valley. Your network isn't who you went to school with anymore
recent_posts.summary: A perspective arguing that X (formerly Twitter) has replaced traditional Silicon Valley networking, claiming that professional networks are no longer defined by educational institutions or geographic proximity but by online presence and engagement on social platforms.

recent_posts.title:
easiest thing to say when your company sells GPUs powering the layoffs.

120,000 tech layoffs in 2026 so far. 

directly blamed on AI
recent_posts.summary: A pointed critique of Nvidia's position in the AI industry, noting the irony that the company selling GPUs powering AI-driven automation is commenting on the 120,000 tech layoffs in 2026 attributed directly to AI adoption.

recent_posts.title:
this feels illegal

turning websites into sales reps
recent_posts.summary: A provocative post about converting websites into automated sales representatives, likely using AI or automation tools. The content is minimal and promotional in nature, with little technical substance.

recent_posts.title:
CEO of Anthropic - Dario Amodei - The most surprising thing regarding current AI timelines is the lack of public recognition and the focus on tired old topics.

We are reaching super intelligence and people are crying about token limits
recent_posts.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, expresses surprise at the lack of public recognition of how close AI development is to superintelligence, contrasting it with what he sees as focus on minor issues like token limits.
